high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "theidolfacts." The background shows intricate architectural details of the temple, including a large wheel and other ornate carvings. The text overlay on the image reads: "INR 10/-" "Sun temple at Konark, Odisha" Below the image, there is a caption that says: "@theidolfacts Share with your friends and fam..."
